verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents one bulk action of its own: acknowledging many simultaneously created incidents with a single tap. Beyond that, the API evidence shows only per-item create, update and delete calls on monitors, and Terraform is a developer building block that earns no credit here. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond incident acknowledgement (bulk edit, delete, pause or resolve), bulk/batch API endpoints, MCP- or agent-driven bulk actions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: 30 incidents get created at the same time. Acknowledge them with a single tap and stop your phone from ringing.
10 incidents created at the same time? Acknowledge them with a single tap and keep your phone from ringing while fixing the issue.
